// waf-malformed: generated by the access-gateway console from WAF group malformed; do not edit.
// rules=1 group-mode=log explicit-modes block=0/log=0/off=1

// malformed-uri (priority 0, log): 畸形 URI 探测
if ((strings.match($req.uri, "%[0-9a-f]{2}%[0-9a-f]{2}%[0-9a-f]{2}"))) {
    ctx.report("waf.log", "malformed-uri");
}

return true;
